description.value: Sushi Royal Tokyo is a Japanese restaurant in downtown Kamloops with a broad menu spanning sushi rolls, sashimi, nigiri, tempura, katsu, teriyaki, and donburi. It offers both dine-in and online ordering, which suits cyclists looking to order ahead or grab a quick meal. Its central Victoria Street location puts it in the heart of Kamloops's downtown core.
